Inteligence report

June 27, 1985 - The battle for Everon is coming to an end. Now would be a good time, I think, to pay a visit to Uncle Ivan at home.

Tonight I'm off to Kolgujev with two other Special Ops soldiers. We're not going in to cause any trouble - if the enemy takes any notice of us, we'll be out there on our own... so I should avoid combat at all costs.

Our orders are just to observe the situation over there. Intel reports the presence of at least three anti-aircraft systems, but we need their exact positions. When we return just before the main attack, under extreme time-pressure, we must know exactly where to go - but for now we have time for recon.
